greeting: Survivor Coral on comms. Stage 2: Sunken City of Tides. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Depths of Mystery. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Navigate the flooded districts.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Navigate the flooded districts; Rescue trapped survivors; Investigate the High Tide Council. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Explore the underwater metropolis and find survivors. Immediate move: Navigate the flooded districts.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: Sunken City of Tides. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Corrupted Council.
rumor: Dock crews report a lighthouse beam that points underwater at midnight.
People keep repeating one clue from Sunken City of Tides: 'Investigate the High Tide Council'.
I catalog omens by flavor now. Today tastes like burnt citrus and bad decisions.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn tide is calm enough for precision dives. Best window for route checks.
dialog.time_noon: Noon currents fight each other in the trench. Anchor and communicate.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk visibility drops fast underwater. Stay on beacon chain.
dialog.time_night: Night tide carries deep-song interference. Confirm orders twice.

party_reactions.kade: Survivor Coral sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Survivor Coral accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Survivor Coral talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
